propositions: The sidecar channel's _ALLOWED_FIELDS allowlist admits ceiling limits (request_limit, tool_calls_limit) but drops consumption measurements (requests, tool_calls), preventing durable recording of what was consumed.
Five of six emit_gate_error call sites in workflow/gate_dispatch.py pass no diagnostic parameter, causing plan-review and code-review gate errors to persist no consumption counters to the sidecar.

The completion verdict sidecar payload omits run metadata (requests, tool_calls, duration) while the plan-review sidecar already carries metrics, creating asymmetry between the two gates with the completion gate blind to costs.
Consumption data persists locally in usage.jsonl but is invisible to rebar audit show and ticket store, making gate cost analysis answerable locally but not from shared storage.
rebar audit show must surface gate consumption metrics (requests, tool_calls, duration) generically from the sidecar record to make cost analysis actionable across all agents.
